description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app that handles the initiation of managed profile provisioning, including UI interactions and intent handling.

classes.name: SetupProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the setup process for a managed profile, including UI and provisioning logic.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of SetupProfileFragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up click listener for the profile setup button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, triggers provisioning when the setup button is clicked.

methods.name: provisionManagedProfile
methods.description: Starts the managed profile provisioning process via intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the provisioning activity, shows success or failure message.
